lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular geometric grid along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae, with high-intensity blobs positioned at the intersection nodes, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank; the primary medial ridge exhibits a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of high-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the leading edge and base of the fin structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the pectoral fin and mid-body.
